osa_gen1_legend_support_desc:
Allow full costomization of first generation legendary skins. Restart required.
Automatically enabled when using Super Duper Skin Swapper.
osa_hide_unowned_legend_desc:
Hide legendary attachments for skins you do not own.
Legendary attachments are always hidden if customize legendary skins is disabled.
osa_always_keep_desc:
Confirmation dialog will not ask which attachments to use.
Does not affect previews.
osa_autoswap_legend_desc:
Automatically switch between real and add-on legendary attachments depending on availability.
Requires Add-On Legendary Attachments mod.
osa_autobuy_missing_desc: Automatically buy missing weapon attachments using Continental coins.
osa_show_failure_desc: Show message if attachments could not be kept.
osa_remove_beardlib_blueprints_desc:
Delete attachments from custom BeardLib skins. Restart required.
Warning: Using a custom skin with DLC attachments you do not own will trigger cheater tags.
osa_preview_mode_desc: Enable dialog menu for choosing attachments and wear when previewing weapon skins.
osa_auto_clear_preview_desc: Automatically clear weapon preview when applying skins or attachments.
osa_paint_scheme_desc: Change default paint scheme for weapon colors.
osa_color_wear_desc: Change default wear for weapon colors.
osa_pattern_scale_desc: Change default pattern scale for weapon colors.
osa_apply_sdss_preset_desc:
Applies a preset of OSA settings recommended for use with SDSS.
Preview and weapon color settings are not affected.
osa_dialog_autokeep: Your current attachments will be kept if available.
